intro:
A sparkling mobile display blocks the road.
A department store clerk smiles brightly while grooming a Furfrou.
introDialogue:
Welcome, valued customer!
Today we have a premium promotional service available even if you are not planning to buy anything!
speaker: Department Store Clerk
title: Department Store Staff
description:
A department store clerk is running a special promotion with Furfrou.
She is polite, but somehow hard to refuse.
battleWon: Wonderful work! As promised, let me show you our special techniques.

1.label: Join the Demo Battle
1.tooltip:
(!) Battle the clerk's party
(+) Teach one Pokemon a special move if you win
1.selected:
An excellent choice!
Please prove yourself against my special demonstration team!

2.label: Trade an Item
2.tooltip:
(-) One held item
(+) One higher-tier product
2.selectedDialogue:
Oh my, you brought a fine product.
I will exchange it for one of our premium recommendations.
2.invalidSelection: No Pokemon has a transferable held item.

3.label: Refresh the Party
3.selected:
Conditioning before battle is the foundation of shopping.
Furfrou, let us freshen up the customer's party!

4.label: Quietly Pass By
4.selected: Oh, customer! I still had seventeen benefits left to explain!

outro: Please visit the department store again!
